summary: This bill nullifies a rule issued by the Bureau of Land Management concerning the North Dakota Field Office Record of Decision and Approved Resource Management Plan, preventing it from taking effect.

scores.thoughts: This bill disapproves a Bureau of Land Management (BLM) Resource Management Plan for North Dakota. Resource Management Plans typically include provisions for environmental protection alongside resource development. Disapproving such a plan, especially one that has been deemed a 'rule' under the Congressional Review Act, would likely remove or prevent the implementation of environmental regulations or protections that would have been part of the plan, thus leading to less environmental protection.
